title: REPLI-g Advanced DNA Single Cell Kit (WGA)
author: Alejandro De Santiago
materials: Thaw all the reagents: DTT (purple cap) Buffer DLB (clear cap) Stop solution (red cap) H 2 0 sc (clear cap) REPLI-g advanced sc Reaction Buffer (yellow cap) REPLI-g sc DNA Polymerase (blue cap) The REPLI-g sc DNA Polymerase (blue cap) must thaw on ice!

Prepare the Amplification Master Mix : Add reagents in this order! Vortex and centrifuge before adding the DNA polymerase 9 µL * n of H 2 O sc 29 µL * n of REPLI-g advanced sc Reaction Buffer (yellow cap) 2 µL * n of REPLI-g sc DNA Polymerase (blue cap)
When opening a new REPLI-g Advanced DNA Single Cell Kit Qiagen Catalog #150365 , prepare Buffer DLB (clear cap) by adding 250 µL H 2 O . Vortex to mix and centrifuge.

Pick individual nematodes into tubes containing 4 µL REPLI-g Advanced Storage Buffer ( REPLI-g Single Cell Cryo-Protect Reagent Qiagen Catalog #150370 ). Pick one worm per tube for genome skimming of single specimens. Live specimens work best, followed by samples previously flash frozen. If using frozen samples, thaw samples and transfer worms into tubes containing Repli G Advanced Storage Buffer as quickly as possible. Specimens left at room temperature for too long will degrade quickly and not result in good sequence data.

steps.title: Prepare Buffer D2
steps.instruction: Prepare Buffer D2 for 12 reactions by combining the following reagents:

substeps.instruction: Add 3 µL of 1 Molarity (M) DTT (purple cap).
Add 33 µL of reconstituted buffer DLB (clear cap).

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Add 3 µL of Buffer D2 to the PCR tube containing the nematode suspended in Repli G Advanced Storage Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Mix the tube by vortexing and centrifuge briefly.

steps.title: Incubate Sample
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample based on the cell type:

substeps.instruction: For bacterial cells: Incubate at 65 °C for 10 minutes.
For eukaryotic cells: Incubate at room temperature.

steps.title: Add Stop Solution
steps.instruction: Add 3 µL of the Stop Solution (red cap) to the tube and mix by slowly pipetting up and down.

steps.title: Add Amplification Master Mix
steps.instruction: Add 40 µL of the Amplification Master Mix to the tube containing the lysed worm and mix by slowly pipetting up and down.

steps.title: Incubate for Amplification
steps.instruction: Incubate at 30 °C for 2 hours. If using a heated lid, set the lid temperature to 70 °C.

steps.title: Inactivate Reactions
steps.instruction: Heat the samples at 65 °C for 3 minutes to inactivate the reactions.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store DNA at -20 °C for long-term storage (a concentration of at least 100 ng/μL is recommended).
